title: W8 post-exit Back re-entry arm has no dispatch pin — reverting is_demo_route from the nav arm stays green

title: still present since round 4: pdf_prebake regen docs promise a positional CLI arg that main() never reads (RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR env is the real switch)
evidence: Header: `//// Regenerate (after fixture craft changes): //// gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake -- server/priv //// (cwd = server/; the arg is the priv dir. Defaults to "priv" relative //// to the server package root.)` — but main() reads only the env var: `let priv_dir = case envoy.get("RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR") { Ok(dir) -> dir Error(_) -> "priv" }`. The positional arg is discarded by the BEAM runner; following the documented command writes to priv/, not server/priv.
detail: The documented regen command silently writes PDFs to the wrong directory; the env switch is undocumented in the header (only in a main() comment).
recommended_fix: Fix the header to the real invocation (RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR=... gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake) or read the argv positional in main().

title: still present since round 4: pdf_prebake payloads duplicate the client fixture stories across two packages with no mechanical consistency check
evidence: pdf_prebake.gleam header: `//// The applicant payloads below mirror the client fixture stories in //// client/src/demo/ (same names, incomes, scores, flags). If the demo //// story changes, update BOTH sides — the PDFs are static assets and do //// not re-render themselves.` — a comment, not a check. W12 proved the failure mode: the baked Grace flag said 58% while the fixture arithmetic gave 98% (fixed this round by hand at pdf_prebake.gleam: `{"label":"Income covers 98% of the rent requirement, just below the 100% threshold"...`). recommended_fix: Add a server unit test embedding the same strings demo_store uses (or a shared fixture module) and asserting payload equality, plus a staleness check on the PDF mtimes in CI.
